description: A tiny friend in your Mac's notch and on your iPhone that keeps an eye on your AI coding agents: Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Antigravity and more. Approve from the notch or your Lock Screen.

summary.one_liner: Coucou is an open-source (MIT) macOS/Windows/Linux notch-or-top-bar companion app, with an iPhone and Android companion, that monitors AI coding agent sessions like Claude Code and Codex, handles permission approvals, and adds voice dictation, chat, and integrations.
summary.what_it_does: Coucou sits in the Mac's notch, or at the top edge of the screen on Windows and Linux, and shows live sessions for many AI coding agents, including Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Antigravity, Copilot CLI and others, with each step, file edit and command. It shows Claude Code permission requests and AskUserQuestion prompts so you can Allow, Deny or answer from the notch. The Mac app also includes Flow dictation that pastes speech into any app, with optional offline Parakeet recognition, and a Notetaker that transcribes calls without a bot. Chat is available with Claude, Gemini, OpenAI, DeepSeek, Qwen, Moonshot and local Ollama or LM Studio models, using API keys or some CLI subscriptions. Integrations pills cover GitHub, Stripe, Vercel, n8n, Notion and others. An iPhone app adds Live Activities, Face ID approvals and widgets over iCloud, and a separate Android app links to the Windows or Linux version over Wi-Fi.
use_cases: monitor multiple AI coding agent sessions at a glance
approve or deny agent permission requests without switching windows
dictate text into any app with a hotkey
record and summarize calls without a meeting bot
approve agent actions from an iPhone lock screen
chat with several LLM providers from a menu-bar-style panel
how_to_run: git clone the repository, cd coucou/NotchBuddy, xcodegen, open NotchBuddy.xcodeproj (macOS build from source, requires macOS 15+, Xcode 16+)
cd coucou/windows, npm install, npm run pack (Windows or Linux build from source)
Download the Coucou.zip from Releases, move Coucou.app to /Applications, and launch it
notable: Mochi, an animated mascot in the notch that reacts to agent states and alerts
Approve Claude Code permissions and answer AskUserQuestion prompts from the notch, with Face ID approvals on iPhone
Flow dictation with optional fully offline Parakeet model on Apple silicon
Supports macOS, Windows, Linux, iPhone and Android companions, with the Android app built by a community contributor
Keys are stored in the OS keychain or secret service, with no telemetry and no account
caveats: Many features are macOS-only, and some, like plan usage and Apple Music, need the GitHub build rather than the App Store build, which is sandboxed.
The iPhone app is a TestFlight beta, the App Store version is still coming, and it needs iOS 18 or later and Coucou 0.1.9 or later on the Mac.
The WhatsApp integration is experimental and relies on an unofficial gateway that WhatsApp may restrict.
Windows installer is not code-signed, so SmartScreen warns on first run; Android needs a Windows or Linux computer and Android 11+.
